The company values technical expertise, collaboration, and innovation, offering opportunities for growth and development to professionals in the electrical engineering field. Role Description The Deputy Manager and Design Power Transformer role is a full-time on-site position based in Cairo, Egypt. This role is responsible for overseeing the design and development of power transformers, including preparing technical designs, specifications, and drawings, and ensuring compliance with relevant standards and client requirements. Day-to-day tasks include coordinating with engineering, production, and quality teams; reviewing and approving design calculations; and resolving technical issues during manufacturing and testing. The role involves participating in project planning, supporting tender and proposal activities with technical input, and optimizing designs for performance, cost, and reliability. Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field; an advanced degree or relevant professional certifications are an advantage. Previous experience in transformer or heavy electrical equipment design and manufacturing is highly beneficial; experience in a managerial or deputy managerial role is a plus.
